beginner.summary: For developers, testers and operations engineers starting with GitLab CI/CD. Covers projects, groups, issues and merge requests, writing .gitlab-ci.yml with stages and jobs, running and reading pipelines, runners and executors, Docker images and services, CI/CD variables and secrets, artifacts and caching, rules, building and testing applications, test and coverage reports, container images and the registry, environments and deployments, merge request pipelines, security scanning, packages and releases, GitLab Pages and debugging failed pipelines.
prerequisites: Uses Git for commits, branches and merges
Knows what an automated build and test does
outcomes: Write .gitlab-ci.yml pipelines with stages, jobs, rules, artifacts and caching
Build, test, scan and package applications and container images in GitLab
Deploy to environments from merge request and main branch pipelines
Use runners, variables and secrets safely and debug failed pipelines

days.topic: GitLab CI/CD Overview: Projects, Pipelines and Runners
subtopics: What GitLab CI/CD does in the software delivery flow
Runners and how jobs reach them
Pipeline triggers: pushes, merge requests and schedules
GitLab compared with Jenkins and GitHub Actions
Course project overview: a web application with an API
days.lab_task: Create a group and a project for the course application, push the code, add a two-job pipeline from the pipeline editor and watch it run.
days.deliverable: Project with a first running pipeline
checks: The project sits in a group with members
Pipeline, stage, job and runner are explained correctly

days.topic: GitLab Projects, Groups, Merge Requests and Issues
days.lab_task: Set up protected branches, labels and an issue board, open an issue, fix it on a branch, review the merge request with a partner and merge it after approval.
days.deliverable: Configured project with a reviewed and merged change
checks: The main branch only accepts merge requests
The merge request has comments and an approval
The issue closes when the merge request merges

days.topic: Writing .gitlab-ci.yml: Stages, Jobs and Scripts
days.lab_task: Write a pipeline with build, test and package stages, use defaults for the image and before_script, validate it in the editor and fix three planted YAML mistakes.
checks: Jobs run in the planned stages
All planted mistakes are found and fixed

days.topic: Running Pipelines and Reading Job Logs
days.lab_task: Add a manual job and a nightly schedule, run a pipeline with a custom variable, use log sections in a long job and set up failure notifications.
days.deliverable: Pipeline with manual, scheduled and logged jobs
checks: The manual job waits until started
The nightly pipeline runs on schedule
Log sections make the long job readable

days.topic: Runners: Shared, Group and Project Runners and Executors
days.lab_task: Install and register a project runner with the Docker executor, tag it, route one job to it with tags and compare it with a hosted runner.
checks: The runner appears online for the project
The tagged job runs on the new runner
Hosted and self-managed runners are compared

days.topic: Docker Images, Services and the Docker Executor
subtopics: Services such as databases in jobs
days.lab_task: Run integration tests against a PostgreSQL service in a job, pin all image versions and build an image with a rootless builder instead of privileged Docker-in-Docker.
days.deliverable: Jobs using services and a rootless image build
checks: The image build runs without privileged mode

days.topic: Variables, Secrets and Protected Branches
subtopics: Secrets that must never be printed
Variables from pipeline runs and schedules
days.lab_task: Add project and group variables with masking, protection and environment scopes, use a file variable for a credential, prove that protected variables are absent on feature branches and fix a script that would print a secret.
checks: Protected variables are only available on protected branches
Masked values do not appear in logs
Environment-scoped variables apply to the right deployments

days.topic: Artifacts, Caching and Job Dependencies
days.lab_task: Pass build output to test and package jobs with artifacts, cache dependencies with a lock-file key and measure pipeline time before and after caching.
checks: Later jobs use the build artifacts
The cache hits on the second run

days.topic: Rules and Workflow Control: When Jobs Run
subtopics: rules compared with only and except
Conditions on branches, tags and variables
days.lab_task: Add rules so tests run on every push, deployment runs only on main, documentation jobs run only when docs change, and duplicate branch and merge request pipelines are avoided.
checks: Jobs appear only under their conditions
Docs jobs run only when docs change
Only one pipeline runs per change

days.topic: Building and Testing Applications in Pipelines
days.lab_task: Build the course application once, run lint, unit and integration tests in parallel and test two runtime versions with a matrix job.
days.deliverable: Build and test pipeline with a matrix

days.topic: Test Reports, Code Coverage and Merge Request Widgets
days.lab_task: Publish JUnit and coverage reports, show coverage in merge request diffs, add a code quality report and review a merge request using the widgets.
days.deliverable: Pipeline publishing reports to merge requests
checks: Test results appear in the merge request

days.topic: Building and Pushing Container Images to the GitLab Registry
subtopics: Building with Docker or Kaniko-style builders
Tagging with commit SHA and versions
days.lab_task: Build the application image, push it with commit and version tags using the job token, set a cleanup policy and pull the image in a later test job.
checks: Images appear in the registry with both tags
Jobs use the job token, not personal tokens

days.topic: Environments and Deployments
days.lab_task: Create staging and production environments, deploy to staging automatically and production after approval, then roll back production to the previous deployment.
checks: The rollback restores the previous version

days.topic: Deploying to a Server or Cloud Service
subtopics: Deploying to a cloud platform service
Recording what was deployed and when
days.lab_task: Deploy the application to a cloud platform service with short-lived credentials, run a health check after deployment and fail the job when the check fails.
days.deliverable: Cloud deployment job with health check
checks: The application runs on the target
No long-lived cloud keys are stored
A failed health check fails the job

days.topic: Merge Request Pipelines and Approvals
days.lab_task: Configure merge request pipelines, require a successful pipeline and code owner approval, block merges with unresolved threads and test the rules with a sample change.
days.deliverable: Merge request rules with a tested change
checks: Merge is blocked until the pipeline passes

days.topic: Security Scanning: SAST, Secret Detection and Dependency Scanning
days.lab_task: Add SAST, secret detection and dependency scanning, plant a secret and a vulnerable dependency, see them in the merge request and fix both.
checks: The planted secret and vulnerable dependency are reported

days.topic: Package Registry and Releases
days.lab_task: Publish a library package from a tag pipeline, create a release with notes and assets, and consume the package from a second project.
checks: The package appears in the registry
The release has notes and assets
The second project installs the package

days.topic: GitLab Pages for Documentation Sites
tools: Static site generator such as MkDocs
days.lab_task: Publish the project's documentation with GitLab Pages from a pages job, restrict access to project members and rebuild it automatically on merge.
checks: The site is served by GitLab Pages
Only members can view the site
Docs rebuild on merge to main

days.topic: Debugging Failed Pipelines
subtopics: Debug logging with CI_DEBUG_TRACE and its risks
days.lab_task: Diagnose five broken pipelines (a YAML error, a missing variable, a wrong image, a runner tag mismatch and a flaky test), fix them and write a debugging checklist.
checks: Each failure has a recorded cause
The checklist covers the steps used

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: CI/CD Pipeline for a Web Application
days.lab_task: Build a complete pipeline for the course application with build, tests, reports, security scanning, image publishing, staging and approved production deployments and merge request rules.
checks: A change flows from merge request to production
Approvals, protected variables and rules are in place
Tests, coverage and security results show in merge requests

intermediate.summary: For engineers who maintain GitLab pipelines for teams. Covers pipeline architecture with needs, parent-child and multi-project pipelines, reusable configuration, CI/CD components and the catalog, inputs, merge trains, runners at scale, OIDC ID tokens, external secrets, Kubernetes deployments with the GitLab agent, GitOps, infrastructure as code pipelines, review apps, release strategies, security and pipeline execution policies, DAST and container scanning, pipeline performance, monorepos, CI analytics and DORA metrics and AI help with GitLab Duo.
prerequisites: Writes .gitlab-ci.yml pipelines with rules, artifacts and environments
Has deployed an application from GitLab
Comfortable with Docker and basic Kubernetes
outcomes: Design fast, reusable pipelines with components, inputs and parent-child pipelines
Deploy to Kubernetes and clouds with OIDC, external secrets and GitOps
Enforce security with scanners and policies across projects
Measure and improve pipeline speed and delivery performance

days.topic: Pipeline Architecture: DAG with needs, Parent-Child and Multi-Project Pipelines
subtopics: Passing variables and artifacts across pipelines
days.lab_task: Restructure a slow stage-based pipeline into a needs-based graph, split a component into a child pipeline and trigger a downstream deployment project with variables.
checks: Jobs start as soon as their needs finish
The child pipeline runs from the parent

days.topic: Reusable Configuration: include, extends, Anchors and !reference
subtopics: include: local, project, remote and template
days.lab_task: Move repeated job settings into a shared configuration project, reuse them with include and extends, use !reference for scripts and show the merged configuration in the editor.
days.deliverable: Shared configuration used by two projects
checks: Two projects include the shared configuration
The merged configuration is correct in the editor

days.topic: CI/CD Components and the CI/CD Catalog
days.lab_task: Build a component for building and scanning container images, version and publish it to the catalog, and use it from two projects with different settings.
days.deliverable: Published component used by two projects
checks: The component runs in its own test pipeline
A tagged version appears in the catalog

days.topic: Inputs with spec:inputs for Configurable Pipelines
subtopics: Why inputs beat variables for configuration
Inputs for components and included files
days.lab_task: Add typed inputs with defaults and allowed options to the image component, reject an invalid value, and expose inputs for a manual release pipeline.
days.deliverable: Component and pipeline with validated inputs
checks: Inputs have types, defaults and options
An invalid value is rejected before the pipeline starts

days.topic: Merge Trains and Merged Results Pipelines
subtopics: Why main breaks after green merge requests
When trains are not worth it
days.lab_task: Enable merged results pipelines and merge trains, queue four merge requests where one conflicts logically with another and show the train catching the break before main.
days.deliverable: Merge train setup with break evidence
checks: Merged results pipelines run for merge requests
The train stops the breaking merge request

days.topic: Self-Managed Runners at Scale: Autoscaling and the Kubernetes Executor
days.lab_task: Deploy a runner with the Kubernetes executor using Helm, set resource requests per job, run parallel jobs from two projects and monitor queue and job metrics.
checks: The runner registers from the cluster
Parallel jobs run in separate pods
Queue and job metrics appear in dashboards

days.topic: OIDC ID Tokens for Cloud Authentication
subtopics: Why long-lived cloud keys are risky
Trust relationships in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
Restricting by project, branch and environment
tools: AWS IAM or Azure Entra ID or Google Cloud IAM
days.lab_task: Replace stored cloud keys with OIDC in a deployment job, restrict trust to the main branch and production environment, and prove a feature branch cannot assume the role.
checks: The job gets short-lived cloud credentials
Feature branches cannot assume the role
No long-lived keys remain in CI/CD settings

days.topic: External Secrets: HashiCorp Vault and Cloud Secret Managers
days.lab_task: Read deployment secrets from Vault in a job using ID token authentication, scope access to one path per environment and rotate a secret without changing the pipeline.
checks: Each environment reads only its path

days.topic: Deploying to Kubernetes with the GitLab Agent
subtopics: CI/CD access to clusters through the agent
Deploying with kubectl or Helm from jobs
days.lab_task: Install the agent in a cluster, give one project CI/CD access, deploy the application with Helm from a job and view the environment's resources in GitLab.
checks: The application deploys through the agent
Other projects cannot use the agent

days.topic: GitOps with GitLab and Flux or Argo CD
subtopics: Updating image tags through merge requests
days.lab_task: Set up GitOps with Flux or Argo CD reading a GitLab repository, promote a new image from staging to production with merge requests and roll back with a revert.
days.deliverable: GitOps flow with promotion and rollback
checks: The cluster matches the GitOps repository
Promotion happens through a merge request
A revert restores the previous version

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code Pipelines with Terraform and OpenTofu
days.lab_task: Build an infrastructure pipeline that shows plans in merge requests, stores state in GitLab, requires approval for apply and runs a nightly drift check.
objectives: Run infrastructure as code in GitLab

days.topic: Review Apps for Merge Requests
subtopics: Linking review apps in merge requests
days.lab_task: Deploy a review app for every merge request with seeded data, link it in the merge request, run smoke tests against it and stop it automatically after merge.
checks: Each merge request gets its own app
Smoke tests run against the review app

days.topic: Release Strategies: Canary, Blue-Green and Feature Flags
days.lab_task: Release a change as a canary to ten percent of traffic, then behind a feature flag to a user list, and roll back automatically when an error-rate check fails.
days.deliverable: Canary and feature flag releases with rollback
checks: The feature reaches only the user list

days.topic: Security Policies and Pipeline Execution Policies
days.lab_task: Create a security policy project, enforce scans on all projects in a group, require security approval for critical findings and inject a compliance job with a pipeline execution policy.
checks: Scans run in every group project
The compliance job runs in all pipelines

days.topic: DAST, Container Scanning and Vulnerability Management
days.lab_task: Run DAST against a review app and container scanning on the image, triage findings in the vulnerability report, create issues with due dates and report posture for the project.
checks: DAST and container scanning both run
Issues with due dates exist for real findings

days.topic: Pipeline Performance: Caching, Parallel Jobs and Faster Feedback
days.lab_task: Find the critical path of a slow pipeline, apply caching, test splitting, interruptible jobs and smaller images, and cut the merge request feedback time by an agreed target.

days.topic: Monorepo Pipelines with rules:changes and Child Pipelines
days.lab_task: Build monorepo pipelines that start child pipelines only for changed components, handle a shared library change that affects two components and compare duration with running everything.
checks: Duration is compared with full runs

days.topic: Observability for Pipelines: CI Analytics and DORA Metrics
subtopics: Change failure rate and time to restore
days.lab_task: Set up DORA metrics for the project's production environment, review CI analytics for flaky and slow jobs and agree two improvements with the team.
checks: DORA metrics are shown for production
Flaky and slow jobs are identified

days.topic: GitLab Duo for CI/CD: Root Cause Analysis and Pipeline Help
subtopics: Root cause analysis of failed jobs
days.lab_task: Use GitLab Duo to explain three failed jobs and suggest fixes, check each suggestion before applying it and record which were correct.
days.deliverable: AI-assisted fixes with a review record
checks: Duo explanations are recorded for three failures
Each suggestion is checked before use
Correct and incorrect suggestions are counted

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Reusable Pipeline Components for a Product Team
days.lab_task: Build a component library with inputs for a product team, deploy through OIDC, Vault and the Kubernetes agent or GitOps, enforce security policies and show pipeline time and DORA metrics.
checks: No long-lived secrets remain and policies are enforced
Pipeline time and DORA metrics are reported
objectives: Build reusable delivery for a team

advanced.summary: For platform engineers and DevOps leads who run GitLab CI/CD for an organisation. Covers CI/CD platform design, governance and compliance frameworks, supply chain security with provenance, signing and SBOMs, runner fleet operations, self-managed GitLab administration, high availability and Geo, migrations from Jenkins and GitHub Actions, monorepo and polyrepo strategy, progressive delivery at scale, policy as code, value stream analytics, multi-cloud pipelines, secrets strategy, cost optimisation, testing pipeline configuration, a company CI/CD catalog, AI agents, regulated delivery and troubleshooting at scale.
prerequisites: Maintains GitLab pipelines and runners for several teams
Comfortable with Kubernetes, cloud IAM and security scanning
outcomes: Design and govern a GitLab CI/CD platform for many teams
Secure the software supply chain from commit to deployment
Operate GitLab, runners and pipelines reliably and at sensible cost
Lead migrations and measure delivery performance across the organisation

days.topic: CI/CD Platform Design for Many Teams on GitLab
days.lab_task: Design the GitLab platform for an organisation with five product groups, covering group structure, shared components, runners, policies and self-service, and present it to role-played engineering leads.
checks: Structure, components, runners and policies are defined

days.topic: Governance: Compliance Frameworks, Audit Events and Approval Rules
subtopics: Protected branches and environments across groups
days.lab_task: Define a compliance framework, apply it to regulated projects, stream audit events to a log store and produce a compliance report for a role-played auditor.
checks: Audit events reach the log store
The auditor's questions are answered from the report

days.topic: Supply Chain Security: SLSA Provenance, Signing and SBOMs
days.lab_task: Generate provenance and an SBOM for the application image, sign it with keyless signing, and block unsigned images from deploying with an admission policy.
days.deliverable: Signed images, SBOMs and a deployment gate
checks: Images are signed in the pipeline
Unsigned images are rejected by the cluster

days.topic: Runner Fleet Operations: Capacity, Cost and Isolation
days.lab_task: Size a runner fleet from a month of job data, configure autoscaling with spot capacity, isolate a sensitive project's runners and report cost per team.
days.deliverable: Fleet design, configuration and cost report
checks: Capacity matches peak demand with headroom
Sensitive jobs run only on isolated runners

days.topic: Self-Managed GitLab Administration: Architecture, Upgrades and Backups
subtopics: Linux package and Helm chart installs
tools: GitLab Helm chart or Linux package
days.lab_task: Install a test self-managed GitLab, plan an upgrade path across two versions, back up and restore to a new server and monitor key services.
days.deliverable: Upgrade plan, restore evidence and monitoring
checks: The upgrade path follows the required stops
The restore brings back projects and pipelines

days.topic: GitLab High Availability and Geo for Disaster Recovery
subtopics: Recovery time and recovery point objectives
days.lab_task: Design an HA and Geo setup for stated recovery objectives, run a failover drill in a test environment and update the runbook from what happened.
days.deliverable: DR design, drill results and runbook
checks: The runbook is updated from the drill

days.topic: Migrating from Jenkins and GitHub Actions to GitLab CI
subtopics: Mapping Jenkins and Actions concepts to GitLab
Running old and new pipelines in parallel
days.lab_task: Inventory ten pipelines, convert a Jenkinsfile and an Actions workflow to GitLab CI, run both versions in parallel for a week and plan the remaining waves.
days.deliverable: Inventory, converted pipelines and migration plan
checks: Pipelines are listed with complexity ratings
Both converted pipelines produce the same results
Waves, training and retirement are planned

days.topic: Large Monorepo and Polyrepo Strategies
days.lab_task: Compare monorepo and polyrepo designs for a product family, implement automated dependency updates across five repositories and coordinate a multi-repo release.
checks: Both strategies are compared on agreed criteria
Dependency updates open merge requests across repositories
The multi-repo release completes in order

days.topic: Progressive Delivery at Scale with Feature Flags and Canary Analysis
tools: GitLab feature flags or a flag service
days.lab_task: Add automated canary analysis for two services with release health metrics, set feature flag cleanup rules and run a release that rolls back on a failed analysis.
days.deliverable: Canary analysis setup and rollback evidence
checks: Canary analysis uses agreed health metrics
Stale flags are found by the cleanup rule

days.topic: Policy as Code and Security Gates Across Groups
subtopics: Policy layers: GitLab policies, OPA and admission control
days.lab_task: Write policies for required scans, approved base images and production approvals, roll them out in warn mode then enforce mode and report the impact on teams.
days.deliverable: Policies with rollout and impact report
checks: Blocked changes and exceptions are reported

days.topic: Value Stream Analytics and Engineering Metrics
days.lab_task: Configure value stream analytics for three groups, compare their flow and DORA metrics, find one bottleneck per group and agree improvements without ranking teams.
checks: One bottleneck per group is identified
Improvements are agreed with each team

days.topic: Multi-Cloud Deployment Pipelines
tools: AWS, Azure and Google Cloud CLIs
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that deploys the same service to two clouds with OIDC, promotes across regions with a matrix and tests switching traffic to the second cloud.
checks: The service deploys to both clouds
Traffic switches to the second cloud

days.topic: Secrets Management Strategy for an Organisation
tools: HashiCorp Vault or cloud secret managers
days.lab_task: Audit secrets across projects, design a central strategy with short-lived credentials and rotation, enable push protection and run a leaked-secret incident drill.
days.deliverable: Secrets audit, strategy and drill record
checks: Stored secrets are inventoried by risk
The strategy covers storage, rotation and access
The leaked-secret drill completes with lessons

days.topic: Pipeline Cost Optimisation
subtopics: Storage for artifacts, caches and registries
days.lab_task: Analyse a month of CI/CD cost, set artifact and registry cleanup, right-size job resources and show cost per team before and after.
checks: Cost is broken down by compute and storage
Cleanup and right-sizing savings are measured

days.topic: Testing Pipeline Configuration: Linting, Simulation and Component Tests
subtopics: CI lint and merged configuration checks
Testing components in their own projects
days.lab_task: Add lint, simulation and golden configuration tests for the shared components, catch a breaking change before release and publish a fixed version.
days.deliverable: Tested components with a caught breaking change
checks: The breaking change fails the test

days.topic: Building and Publishing a Company CI/CD Catalog
days.lab_task: Publish five company components with standards, documentation and deprecation rules, track adoption across projects and accept a contribution from another team.
checks: An external contribution is reviewed and merged

days.topic: AI-Assisted Delivery with GitLab Duo Agents
subtopics: AI agents in the delivery workflow
days.lab_task: Pilot Duo agents for failed pipeline fixes and merge request reviews on one project, require human approval for every change and measure accepted and rejected suggestions.
checks: All agent changes need human approval
Accepted and rejected suggestions are counted

days.topic: Regulated Delivery: Separation of Duties and Evidence
days.lab_task: Configure separation of duties for a regulated service, generate change evidence automatically from merge requests and deployments and walk a role-played auditor through one release.
days.deliverable: Regulated delivery setup and audit walkthrough
checks: Authors cannot approve or deploy their own changes
The auditor accepts the release evidence

days.topic: Troubleshooting Pipelines and Runners at Scale
days.lab_task: Diagnose four platform incidents (queued jobs, registry rate limits, an inherited variable surprise and a Gitaly slowdown), fix them and write a platform troubleshooting guide.
checks: Each incident has a confirmed cause
The guide covers the steps used

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: GitLab CI/CD Platform for an Engineering Organisation
days.lab_task: Build a GitLab CI/CD platform for three teams with a component catalog, security policies, signed artefacts, an autoscaling runner fleet, cost reports and delivery metrics, and present it to engineering leadership.
checks: Teams deliver through the catalog and policies
Signed artefacts and policy gates are enforced
